title: Dry Swab Sampling and Transportation
author: Chunan Liu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kaecsbe

steps.title: Break tube seal
steps.instruction: Break the seal around the tube that contains the swab.

steps.title: Prepare swabbing area
steps.instruction: Designate the location to be swabbed, record the size of the area, and remove the swab from its tube.

substeps.instruction: Designate location and note area size

steps.title: Perform swab
steps.instruction: Swab the entire designated area using a zigzag pattern while rolling the swab to ensure the whole swab tip is used.

steps.title: Return swab, cap, and label
steps.instruction: Carefully insert the swab back into the tube, firmly seat the cap, and label the tube with a unique identifier such as patient_ID, sampling location, and date.

steps.title: Place tube in biohazard bag
steps.instruction: Place the capped tube into a biohazard bag, seal the bag, and store at room temperature or at 4 °C if available.

steps.title: Package for shipment
steps.instruction: Put the biohazard bag and all paperwork into a Styrofoam container, arrange next‑day delivery, and do not ship over the weekend.
